keywords.def: A decision to do or not do something in the future.
A result or achievement you aim to reach.
To successfully reach a goal or result.
Doing something regularly over a long period.
The most important things you focus on.
The desire or reason for doing something.

sentences.en: Last year, I made an episode where I openly shared my goals and New Year’s resolutions for 2025.
sentences.zh: 去年，我做过一期节目，公开分享了我的 2025 年目标和新年决心。

sentences.en: Now, it’s time to look back and see how I did.
sentences.zh: 现在，是时候回顾过去，看看我完成得怎么样了。

sentences.en: In this episode, I’ll review my 2025 goals.
sentences.zh: 在这期节目中，我将回顾我的 2025 年目标。

sentences.en: I’ talk about what I achieved, what I only partially achieved, and where I failed.
sentences.zh: 我会聊聊我实现了什么，哪些只实现了一部分，以及在哪里失败了。

sentences.en: And there were definitely some failures.
sentences.zh: 而且确实有一些失败的地方。

sentences.en: I’ll also share my personal and professional goals for 2026 and hopefully give you some ideas for your own New Year’s resolutions.
sentences.zh: 我还将分享我 2026 年的个人和职业目标，希望能为你们自己的新年决心提供一些灵感。

sentences.en: Remember, I’m not perfect, and neither are you, but we can try!
sentences.zh: 记住，我并不完美，你也不是，但我们可以去尝试！

sentences.en: Let’s take a look at what I learned last year and what’s coming next.
sentences.zh: 让我们来看看我去年学到了什么，以及接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: I want to start this episode by giving you some practical advice you can use to set meaningful, realistic goals for 2026,and also actually stick to your goals.
sentences.zh: 我想以一些实用的建议来开始这期节目，你可以用它们来为 2026 年设定有意义、切合实际的目标，并且真正坚持下去。

sentences.en: Writing goals is easy. Achieving them is the hard part.
sentences.zh: 写下目标很容易。实现它们才是最难的部分。

sentences.en: You’ll see this later in the episode where I talk about my 2025 successes and failures.
sentences.zh: 接下来的节目中你会看到我聊到 2025 年的成功与失败。

sentences.en: Let’s start with a simple framework that I always recommend: SMART Goals.
sentences.zh: 让我们从我一直推荐的一个简单框架开始：SMART 原则。

sentences.en: This means choosing goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time Bound.
sentences.zh: 这意味着选择具体的（Specific）、可衡量的（Measurable）、可实现的（Achievable）、相关的（Relevant）和有时间限制的（Time Bound）目标。

sentences.en: Instead of vague resolutions like, “I want to get better at English”, try something more concrete, something more specific.
sentences.zh: 不要设定诸如“我想提高英语水平”这样模糊的决心，试着制定更具体、更明确的目标。

sentences.en: “I will complete three listening exercises each week” or “I will learn 10 new words every Friday.
sentences.zh: “我每周完成三次听力练习”或者“我每周五学习 10 个新单词”。

sentences.en: When your goal is clear and achievable, you are far more likely to follow through and keep your goal.
sentences.zh: 当你的目标清晰且可实现时，你更有可能坚持到底并实现目标。

sentences.en: I’d also recommend that you try setting both personal and professional or academic goals.
sentences.zh: 我也建议你尝试同时设定个人目标以及职业或学业目标。

sentences.en: Maybe you want to “improve your health” or “learn a new skill” and at the same time “push forward” in your studies or career.
sentences.zh: 也许你想“改善健康”或“学习新技能”，同时在学业或事业上“取得进展”。

sentences.en: Having a balance between the two gives you a more complete sense of progress.
sentences.zh: 在两者之间保持平衡能让你对进步有更完整的感知。

sentences.en: One of the biggest challenges is sticking to your goals over time.
sentences.zh: 最大的挑战之一是如何随着时间推移坚持目标。

sentences.en: And I think the secret here is tracking.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里的秘诀在于记录。

sentences.en: You need a system that regularly reminds you what you are working toward.
sentences.zh: 你需要一个能够定期提醒你正在朝什么方向努力的系统。

sentences.en: Tracking your goals helps. You write your goals down in a notebook or maybe a calendar, and then you regularly review and adjust your progress toward that goal.
sentences.zh: 记录目标很有帮助。把目标写在笔记本或日历上，然后定期回顾并调整你朝该目标迈进的进度。

sentences.en: Ask yourself… “What worked this month?” “What didn’t work?” “What small change could I make next month to make it easier?”
sentences.zh: 问问自己……“这个月什么方法有效？”“什么方法没用？”“下个月我可以做出什么小改变来让事情变得更容易？”

sentences.en: Tracking keeps you honest and it keeps you motivated.
sentences.zh: 记录能让你对自我保持诚实，并保持动力。

sentences.en: Another important tip is to break your goals into smaller actions.
sentences.zh: 另一个重要的建议是将目标拆分为更小的行动。

sentences.en: Big goals, massive targets, often fail because we feel overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 宏大的目标和庞大的指标往往会失败，因为我们会感到不知所措。

sentences.en: But small steps can help you build momentum.
sentences.zh: 但小步骤可以帮你建立势头。

sentences.en: Also create an environment that helps you succeed.
sentences.zh: 同时，创造一个能助你成功的环境。

sentences.en: Remove any obstacles or friction. Make your habits obvious.
sentences.zh: 消除任何障碍或阻力。让你的习惯显而易见。

sentences.en: For example, if you want to study English in the morning, put your notebook or your listening headphones on your desk the night before.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你想在早上学英语，头天晚上就把笔记本或听力耳机放在桌上。

sentences.en: If you want to exercise more, pack your gym bag ahead of time or lay out your clothes.
sentences.zh: 如果你想多锻炼，提前收拾好健身包或摆好衣服。

sentences.en: Make the goal as easy as possible to start.
sentences.zh: 让目标的启动变得尽可能简单。

sentences.en: For example, last year I wanted to eat out less.
sentences.zh: 比如，去年我想减少在外吃饭的次数。

sentences.en: I wanted to eat my lunch at home every day.
sentences.zh: 我想每天都在家吃午饭。

sentences.en: So one of the easiest ways to do this is to make my lunch the night before.
sentences.zh: 所以最简单的方法之一就是在前一天晚上把午饭做好。

sentences.en: So when I’m making dinner, I also make lunch.
sentences.zh: 这样我在做晚饭时，顺便把午饭也做出来了。

sentences.en: And then, I don’t have to worry. It’s so easy just to eat my lunchbox every day.
sentences.zh: 然后，我就不用操心了。每天带饭吃实在是太轻松了。

sentences.en: The most important tip I want to give you, though, is to be flexible.
sentences.zh: 不过，我想给你们的最重要的建议是：保持灵活性。

sentences.en: Life will change. Your goals will change.
sentences.zh: 生活会变。你的目标也会变。

sentences.en: You will have weeks where nothing goes to plan.
sentences.zh: 总有些星期，一切都计划赶不上变化。

sentences.en: But it is also okay if your goals change or adjust slightly.
sentences.zh: 但如果你的目标发生改变或略作调整，那也是完全没问题的。

sentences.en: You’ll see in a few seconds that I had some unexpected success this year in certain areas, which refocused my plans and my priorities.
sentences.zh: 过一会儿你就会看到，我今年在某些领域取得了意外的成功，这重新调整了我的计划和优先级。

sentences.en: And all of this is okay, be flexible. So now we know how to set goals for next year, I want to take a moment to review how I did with my 2025 goals.
sentences.zh: 这些都没问题，保持灵活就好。既然我们知道了如何为明年设定目标，我想花点时间回顾一下我的 2025 年目标完成得怎么样。

sentences.en: I publicly, exactly a year ago, set both personal and professional targets.
sentences.zh: 整整一年前，我公开设定了个人和职业目标。

sentences.en: I achieved some of these. I partially reached some of my goals.
sentences.zh: 其中一些我实现了。一些目标部分实现了。

sentences.en: And some I didn’t reach at all. I think looking back is really important.
sentences.zh: 还有一些根本没实现。我认为回顾过去真的非常重要。

sentences.en: Looking back and reviewing the past can help you, or help me, understand what worked and what didn’t work.
sentences.zh: 回首和审视过去可以帮助你，或者帮助我，理解什么有效、什么无效。

sentences.en: And also maybe what I can do differently next year.
sentences.zh: 以及明年我能做些什么不同的尝试。

sentences.en: So let’s start with my personal goals from last year.
sentences.zh: 那么，先从我去年的个人目标开始吧。

sentences.en: Last year, my first personal goal was to pass the Japanese Language Proficiency Test N1 level.
sentences.zh: 去年，我的第一个个人目标是通过日语能力测试 N1 级。

sentences.en: This is the highest level of the exam available.
sentences.zh: 这是该考试的最高级别。

sentences.en: I passed the N2 version in July, 2024, so I thought it was a reasonable target to try and step up a level in 2025.
sentences.zh: 我在 2024 年 7 月通过了 N2 版本，所以我觉得在 2025 年挑战升级是一个合理的指标。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, I didn’t dedicate enough time to study at all, so I failed.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我根本没有投入足够的时间学习，所以我失败了。

sentences.en: I have been so busy with Thinking in English and other parts of my life, and this year Japanese study has not really been one of my priorities.
sentences.zh: 我一直忙于 Thinking in English 和生活中的其他事情，今年学日语确实没排在我的优先级前列。

sentences.en: I think the big lesson here is the importance of realistic planning.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里的重要教训是现实规划的重要性。

sentences.en: I set myself a very ambitious goal, like passing an exam, and that is a good thing.
sentences.zh: 我给自己设定了一个非常雄心勃勃的目标，比如通过一场考试，这本身是件好事。

sentences.en: Setting ambitious goals is good. But you also need a clear plan and enough time to achieve your plan.
sentences.zh: 设定宏大的目标很好。但你也需要一个清晰的计划和足够的时间来实现它。

sentences.en: I made myself a plan, but I just didn’t stick to it because other things kept happening.
sentences.zh: 我给自己制定了计划，但就是没有坚持下去，因为总有别的事发生。

sentences.en: My second personal goal was to maintain a consistent gym schedule.
sentences.zh: 我的第二个个人目标是保持规律的健身日程。

sentences.en: I set myself the target of attending the gym at least twice a week and following a workout plan.
sentences.zh: 我给自己定下的目标是每周至少去健身房两次，并遵循健身计划。

sentences.en: I had actually started going to the gym in September, 2024, so I was still quite new when I set the goal last year, but I really wanted to keep going.
sentences.zh: 其实我是在 2024 年 9 月开始去健身房的，所以去年定目标时我还算是个新手，但我真的很想坚持下去。

sentences.en: And I’m happy to say that I have achieved this goal.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴地说，我实现了这个目标。

sentences.en: In fact, I think I averaged three times a week at the gym over the summer months.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为在夏天的几个月里，我去健身房的平均频率是每周三次。

sentences.en: The only times this year that I have been absent from the gym for over one week is in February when it was really heavy snow.
sentences.zh: 今年唯一连续一周多没去健身房的时候是 2 月份，当时下了一场大雪。

sentences.en: It made it impossible for me to get to the gym.
sentences.zh: 这让我根本无法去健身房。

sentences.en: It was too far away. It was really hard to get into the habit of going to the gym early in the morning, three or four times a week.
sentences.zh: 太远了。要在清晨养成每周去三四次健身房的习惯真的很难。

sentences.en: But once I started doing it consistently, it became easier to stick with.
sentences.zh: 但一旦我开始坚持做这件事，就更容易保持下去了。

sentences.en: I also want to make an honorable mention here as well.
sentences.zh: 在这里我还想特别表扬一下自己。

sentences.en: I finally learned to drive this year. And I made an episode discussing my experiences earlier this year as well.
sentences.zh: 我今年终于学会开车了。今年早些时候我还做过一期节目分享我的这段经历。

sentences.en: This wasn’t a goal I set publicly last year, but it has been something that I have been setting as a vague goal every year for about 13 years now.
sentences.zh: 这不是我去年公开设定的目标，但大约 13 年来，它一直是我每年都在敷衍地设定一下的模糊目标。

sentences.en: So I’m proud I achieved it. But learning to drive, probably did negatively affect my Japanese study, because I was learning to drive instead of studying.
sentences.zh: 所以我为自己达成目标感到骄傲。不过学开车可能确实对我的日语学习产生了负面影响，因为我把时间花在学车而不是学习上了。

sentences.en: And then I had to catch up making Thinking in English content, because I was too busy learning to drive in August to make anything.
sentences.zh: 后来我还得赶进度制作 Thinking in English 的内容，因为 8 月份我太忙于学车，什么都没做成。

sentences.en: On the professional side, I aimed for Thinking in English to reach 20 million total podcast downloads this year, and 650,000 Spotify followers.
sentences.zh: 在职业方面，我今年的目标是让 Thinking in English 的播客总下载量达到 2000 万次，Spotify 粉丝达到 65 万。

sentences.en: This was a partial success. We reached over 20 million downloads, but only got to 600,000 Spotify followers.
sentences.zh: 这是一个部分的成功。我们的下载量突破了 2000 万，但 Spotify 粉丝只达到了 60 万。

sentences.en: This year has actually been quite tough for the show on Spotify.
sentences.zh: 今年对这个节目在 Spotify 上的表现来说确实挺艰难的。

sentences.en: Downloads and plays on Spotify are lower than I anticipated or expected this year.
sentences.zh: 今年 Spotify 上的下载量和播放量低于我的预期。

sentences.en: So if you’re listening on Spotify, please listen to a few extra episodes today.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你正在用 Spotify 收听，请今天多听几期节目吧。

sentences.en: But I also experienced unexpected growth on other platforms.
sentences.zh: 但我在其他平台上也经历了意料之外的增长。

sentences.en: At the time of recording this episode, Thinking in English has about 70,000 YouTube subscribers.
sentences.zh: 录制这期节目时，Thinking in English 拥有约 7 万名 YouTube 订阅者。

sentences.en: I started the year with less than 20,000.
sentences.zh: 我今年年初时还不到 2 万。

sentences.en: So this is a massive 50,000 new people. Most of you have come since July.
sentences.zh: 所以这新增了整整 5 万人。你们大部分人都是 7 月以后才来的。

sentences.en: And also I reached a 100,000 Apple Podcast followers, and I’ve had some of the best months ever for Thinking in English on Apple.
sentences.zh: 而且我在 Apple Podcast 上也达到了 10 万粉丝，在 Apple 上，Thinking in English 迎来了有史以来表现最好的几个月之一。

sentences.en: This year has, I guess, shown me or taught me that growth is not always expected.
sentences.zh: 我想今年向我展示或教会我的是，增长并不总是按预期发生的。

sentences.en: It can come from unexpected places. I also set myself the goal to launch a YouTube exclusive series for English learners this year.
sentences.zh: 它可能来自意想不到的地方。我还给自己设定了目标，要在今年为英语学习者推出一个 YouTube 独家系列。

sentences.en: While it wasn’t completely exclusive to YouTube, I have achieved this goal by turning Thinking in English into a video podcast in May this year.
sentences.zh: 虽然它并非完全是 YouTube 独家，但我通过在今年 5 月将 Thinking in English 改版为视频播客，实现了这个目标。

sentences.en: With subtitles and vocabulary popups throughout the episode.
sentences.zh: 节目中带有字幕和词汇弹窗。

sentences.en: Some of you will be watching this video right now on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 你们有些人现在正通过 YouTube 观看这个视频。

sentences.en: These videos have attracted a brand new audience of amazing people, and I’m very happy and proud of the YouTube videos I’ve been making.
sentences.zh: 这些视频吸引了一批令人惊叹的全新观众，我对制作的 YouTube 视频感到非常高兴和自豪。

sentences.en: Finally, I planned to create and launch a physical product.
sentences.zh: 最后，我计划制作并推出一款实体产品。

sentences.en: This one failed. I realized that product design is really not my strength.
sentences.zh: 这个失败了。我意识到产品设计真的不是我的强项。

sentences.en: I spent far too many days trying to design a T-shirt or a mug or a notebook to sell on my website.
sentences.zh: 我花了太多天时间试图设计一件 T 恤、一个马克杯或一本笔记本在我的网站上出售。

sentences.en: And I’ve not liked anything I’ve made. I guess sometimes it’s better to outsource or collaborate with others when you are not good at doing something.
sentences.zh: 而且我对我做出来的东西都不满意。我想当你擅长某事时，有时候最好还是把工作外包或与他人合作。

sentences.en: The takeaway from this section for you guys listening is that success isn’t always simple or binary.
sentences.zh: 这一部分对收听节目的你们来说，收获就是成功并不总是简单或非黑即白的。

sentences.en: It’s not always success or failure. Some of my goals were clear successes, like going to the gym.
sentences.zh: 它不总是只有成功或失败。我的一些目标取得了明显的成功，比如去健身房。

sentences.en: Some were clear failures, like not passing my Japanese exam.
sentences.zh: 有些则是彻底的失败，比如没能通过日语考试。

sentences.en: But other goals changed along the way. Sometimes growth happens in unexpected ways.
sentences.zh: 但其他目标在过程中发生了变化。有时候，增长会以意想不到的方式发生。

sentences.en: Setting goals publicly, like I did, really helps with accountability and motivation.
sentences.zh: 像我一样公开设定目标，真的对督促自我和保持动力大有帮助。

sentences.en: I told you all what I wanted to do and now I’m telling you how I did.
sentences.zh: 我把我想做的事告诉了大家，现在我正向大家汇报我的成果。

sentences.en: So now we’ve looked back at what went well and what didn’t go well last year.
sentences.zh: 所以，既然我们已经回顾了去年进展顺利和不顺利的地方。

sentences.en: It’s time to look forward. I want to share my goals and Thinking in English’s goals for 2026.
sentences.zh: 是时候展望未来了。我想分享我和 Thinking in English 在 2026 年的目标。

sentences.en: These are the personal challenges I’m preparing for.
sentences.zh: 这些是我正在准备迎接的个人挑战。

sentences.en: And maybe some professional milestones I’m aiming at.
sentences.zh: 也许还有我瞄准的一些职业里程碑。

sentences.en: And I guess the mindset I hope to bring into 2026.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是我希望带入 2026 年的心态。

sentences.en: On the personal side, the first goal is taking the JLPT N1, the Japanese, test.
sentences.zh: 在个人方面，第一个目标是参加日语能力测试 JLPT N1。

sentences.en: My aim is simple. Try and pass it this year.
sentences.zh: 我的目标很简单：争取今年通过它。

sentences.en: I’m going to approach it with a clearer study plan and a more focused attitude.
sentences.zh: 我会以更清晰的学习计划和更专注的态度来对待它。

sentences.en: So I don’t want to do anything dramatic.
sentences.zh: 所以我不想搞得太夸张。

sentences.en: My hope is simply make steady and deliberate progress.
sentences.zh: 我的期望仅仅是取得稳步且坚定的进步。

sentences.en: I might actually look for an online Japanese teacher to help me stay more consistent this year.
sentences.zh: 我甚至可能会找一个在线日语老师来帮我今年保持更好的连贯性。

sentences.en: Then there is the biggest personal challenge I will face in 2026, becoming a father.
sentences.zh: 接下来是我在 2026 年将面临的最大个人挑战：成为一名父亲。

sentences.en: In the next few weeks, maybe already by the time you’re listening to this, we will have welcomed a new member into our family.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，也许当你听到这里时，我们已经迎来了家庭的新成员。

sentences.en: My intention is to be a present and supportive father in my child’s life, while also continuing to provide for my family.
sentences.zh: 我的意愿是在孩子的生活中做一个陪伴且支持他的父亲，同时继续为家庭提供经济保障。

sentences.en: It’s a life changing transition. And I want to, kind of, face it with balance and patience.
sentences.zh: 这是一次改变人生的过渡。我希望以平衡和耐心的心态去面对它。

sentences.en: I want to balance Thinking in English with my personal life.
sentences.zh: 我想在 Thinking in English 和我的个人生活之间找到平衡。

sentences.en: Professionally, i’m setting some ambitious but achievable targets.
sentences.zh: 在职业方面，我设定了一些雄心勃勃但可以实现的目标。

sentences.en: I’d love to continue growing the Thinking in English audience.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意继续扩大 Thinking in English 的受众群体。

sentences.en: 650,000 Spotify followers. 100,000 YouTube subscribers is what I’m aiming for.
sentences.zh: 我的目标是 65 万 Spotify 粉丝，100,000 名 YouTube 订阅者。

sentences.en: I would love, really love to have a silver play button from YouTube.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想、真的很想拿到 YouTube 的银色播放按钮。

sentences.en: The plan there is clear though. Keep making things you want to watch and you want to listen to.
sentences.zh: 不过那里的计划很清晰：继续制作你们想看、想听的内容。

sentences.en: I also want to launch an affordable course or a learning challenge, especially for my Patreon supporters.
sentences.zh: 我还想推出一个实惠的课程或学习挑战，特别是为我的 Patreon 支持者准备的。

sentences.en: This would be something practical and accessible.
sentences.zh: 这将是实用且接地气的内容。

sentences.en: I have some plans already, but it just depends on how much time I have in the next few weeks.
sentences.zh: 我已经有一些计划了，但这完全取决于我接下来几周有多少时间。

sentences.en: And finally, I’m hoping to collaborate more.
sentences.zh: 最后，我希望能有更多合作。

sentences.en: I think working with other podcasts or creators could open some new doors for me and bring some new ideas or push me more creatively.
sentences.zh: 我认为与其他播客或创作者合作可以为我打开新大门，带来新创意，或者在创意上给我更多推动力。

sentences.en: I’ve never really done this before, but I think 2026 feels like the right time to try and seek out some collaborations.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未真正做过这种尝试，但我觉得 2026 年是尝试寻找一些合作的好时机。

sentences.en: You’ve heard about my goals for 2026, so remember them and ask me about them next year, but I think it’s your time to think about your goals.
sentences.zh: 你们已经听过了我 2026 年的目标，所以请记住它们，明年再来考考我进展如何，不过现在该轮到你们思考自己的目标了。

sentences.en: What are you planning to achieve or do or stick to next year?
sentences.zh: 你计划在明年实现、去做或者坚持什么？

sentences.en: I know it can be really difficult to set goals for yourself.
sentences.zh: 我知道给自己设定目标可能会非常困难。

sentences.en: So actually I’ve made 10 possible resolutions for a English learner that hopefully should or could be relevant to some of you listening.
sentences.zh: 所以我专门为英语学习者制定了 10 个可能的新年决心，希望能对收听节目的某些人有所启发或产生关联。

sentences.en: So I’m gonna give you these 10 resolutions.
sentences.zh: 所以我要把这 10 个决心分享给你们。

sentences.en: See if any of them are useful for you. First, here are two reading based resolutions.
sentences.zh: 看看其中是否有对你有用的。首先，这里有两个基于阅读的决心。

sentences.en: Read an English news article twice a week, for example on a Tuesday and a Friday, and make a list of five useful vocabulary items each time.
sentences.zh: 每周读两篇英语新闻文章，例如在周二和周五，并且每次记下五个有用的词汇。

sentences.en: Or Read one English book every two months, by reading a chapter or two chapters every Saturday and every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 或者每两个月读一本英文书，方法是每个星期六和星期日读一章或两章。

sentences.en: Next, here are two listening resolutions.
sentences.zh: 接下来，这里有两个听力决心。

sentences.en: Listen to two episodes of the Thinking in English podcast every week.
sentences.zh: 每周听两期 Thinking in English 播客节目。

sentences.en: I release them on Mondays and Fridays. And leave a comment in English on at least one of those episodes.
sentences.zh: 我在周一和周五发布。并且在其中至少一期节目下用英文留言评论。

sentences.en: Practice writing every week. Or Watch at least one English documentary or YouTube video or TV episode every week.
sentences.zh: 每周练习写作。或者每周至少看一部英语纪录片、YouTube 视频或电视剧集。

sentences.en: If you need to, use English subtitles until you no longer need them Here are some writing resolutions.
sentences.zh: 如果需要的话，可以使用英文字幕，直到你不再需要它们为止。这里有一些写作决心。

sentences.en: Write a one page journal entry every week reflecting on something you learned or did in the previous week.
sentences.zh: 每周写一篇一页纸的日记，反思你在过去一周学到了什么或做了什么。

sentences.en: Or Write a review of a restaurant or a shop or somewhere else you visited in English once a month.
sentences.zh: 或者每月用英文写一篇餐馆、商店或你访问过的其他地方的评论。

sentences.en: And if you are brave, post it publicly on Google Maps or something.
sentences.zh: 如果你胆子大一点，把它公开贴在谷歌地图或其他平台上。

sentences.en: Next, speaking resolutions. Record yourself speaking for two to three minutes about any topic once a week.
sentences.zh: 接下来，口语决心。每周围绕任何话题录制两到三分钟的语音。

sentences.en: Review your previous recordings every month or so.
sentences.zh: 差不多每个月回顾一下你之前的录音。

sentences.en: Or Join the Thinking in English Conversation Club once a week and aim to share your opinion five times in this session and ask two questions to other members.
sentences.zh: 或者每周参加一次 Thinking in English 交流俱乐部（Conversation Club），争取在会议中发表五次观点并向其他成员提问两个问题。

sentences.en: Also, here are some general learning resolutions I thought of.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有一些我想到的通用学习决心。

sentences.en: Choose one English sound each month, for example, “TH” or R/L or vowel contrasts, and then practice it for 10 minutes twice a week using any online tool you can find.
sentences.zh: 每个月选择一个英语发音，例如“TH”、R/L 或元音对比，然后使用你能找到的任何在线工具，每周练习两次，每次 10 分钟。

sentences.en: Or Spend 10 minutes every Sunday planning your English study for the next week.
sentences.zh: 或者每个星期天花 10 分钟规划接下来一周的英语学习。

sentences.en: What you are going to read. What you’re going to listen to.
sentences.zh: 你要读什么。你要听什么。

sentences.en: When you’re going to study. What you’re going to practice.
sentences.zh: 你什么时候学习。你要练习什么。

sentences.en: Hopefully one or two of these resolutions will fit into your situation and motivate you to make your own goals for next year.​
sentences.zh: 希望其中一两个决心能契合你的现状，并激励你为明年制定自己的目标。

sentences.en: I want to leave you with a simple message.
sentences.zh: 我想留给你们一个简单的讯息。

sentences.en: Your goals only matter if they matter to you.
sentences.zh: 你的目标只有在对你重要时才真正重要。

sentences.en: I’ve shared my failures, my successes, and my hopes for 2026.
sentences.zh: 我分享了我的失败、我的成功，以及我对 2026 年的期许。

sentences.en: I haven’t done this because I think you all should copy them.
sentences.zh: 我这样做并不是认为你们所有人都应该复制它们。

sentences.en: I’ve done this because I hope they inspire you to think honestly about your own direction for the year ahead.
sentences.zh: 我这么做是因为我希望它们能激励你们，去真诚地思考自己未来一年的方向。

sentences.en: Setting goals isn’t about being perfect.
sentences.zh: 设定目标并不是为了追求完美。

sentences.en: Some of my goals from last year went exactly as planned, and some went in an unexpected direction.
sentences.zh: 我去年的一些目标完全按计划进行了，有些则走向了意料之外的方向。

sentences.en: That will happen to you too, and that’s absolutely fine.
sentences.zh: 这也会发生在你身上，这绝对没问题。

sentences.en: But it’s your turn. What do you want to achieve in 2026?
sentences.zh: 现在轮到你们了。你们在 2026 年想实现什么？

sentences.en: What skill do you want to improve? What habit do you want to build?
sentences.zh: 你想提高什么技能？你想建立什么习惯？

sentences.en: What challenge do you want to finally face?
sentences.zh: 你想要最终直面什么挑战？
